public_rationale: On the ordinary reading of robust as reliable against varied realistic attacks, the contemporary evaluation supports Marcus's assessment. Defenses that performed well on automated single-turn tests remained substantially vulnerable to multi-turn human attacks. Effective attack-specific mitigations existed, so the evidence would not support a stronger claim that industry had done nothing or that every defense was useless.
limitations: The result depends on the stated reading of robust.
The principal study evaluates four defenses, not every commercial deployment.
The reporting quarter is an evaluator choice.
This assesses the 2024 state, not defenses introduced later.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that available defenses did not reliably withstand varied, realistic jailbreak attacks.
Robust does not mean perfect resistance to every conceivable attack.
The statement does not deny the existence of mitigations, successful defenses against particular attacks, or ongoing research.
For the ongoing state without a specified period, use the latest completed calendar quarter before the post, July through September 2024. Earlier work supplies historical context.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations show substantial failures of credible defenses under realistic attack variations, supporting the absence of an established broadly reliable response.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporary evaluations establish an available, practical defense that reliably resists varied adaptive jailbreaks while preserving useful operation. Success against one fixed attack alone is insufficient.

evidence.explanation: The study evaluates four defenses and reports substantial vulnerability to human multi-turn attacks despite strong results against automated single-turn attacks. This supports the ordinary reading that established defenses lacked broad robustness.

Anthropic reports a mitigation reducing one attack's success from 61% to 2%, while also describing weaknesses and possible evasions. This is material evidence against reading Marcus as saying no effective response existed at all; it predates the target quarter and does not establish broad robustness.
